title: Josiah says Auntie told an angel to tell him something

tellings.quote: e Auntie told an angel to tell me auntie was my great aunt and she died at age 89

plain: A boy named Josiah says his late great-aunt, whom he calls Auntie and who died at 89, told an angel to pass a message on to him. His mother tells it as something she saw unfold herself, repeating his own words: "Auntie told an angel to tell me." She tells it on an episode about children said to read minds, because if true it would mean a child getting word from a dead relative.
